paper: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery
headline_agent: reinforcement-fine-tuned LLM factor discovery policy and its mined/fused factor library
component_selection_reason: The paper-specific seed pool, trained checkpoint, mined factors, fusion output, and result arrays are withheld. The public quick-start places return_sharpe_60 first, validates it with the native DSL, and uses the same expression in its local-evaluation example. This source order fixes one attributable executable component without selecting on JKP performance.

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source bar becomes one JKP month; 60 consecutive close-to-close monthly returns replace 60 intraday/daily bars.
monthly_adapter.close: Absolute JKP formation-month prc, preserving the released evaluator's close-return definition and 1e-8 return denominator.
monthly_adapter.operators: Population standard deviation plus the released nested 1e-8 safeguards; no cross-sectional reranking enters the score.
monthly_adapter.universe: Fixed formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities from the common JKP contract.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles; this replaces the released evaluator's equal-mean top/bottom quintile diagnostic.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.
monthly_adapter.warmup: At least 60 consecutive monthly close returns (61 closes); a calendar gap breaks the rolling window.

adapted: source symbols to monthly JKP top-1,000 U.S. universe
